source: Two days later, at a quiet spot on the docks of Banamo Port.
target: Post duas dies, in loco quieto in ripa Portus Banamo.

source: Jenna, dressed in a black outfit that looked like a cross between a dress and a robe, gazed out over the blue ocean shrouded in a thin fog.
target: Jenna, induta habitu nigro, qui quasi inter vestem et togam appareret, intuita est super oceanum caeruleum, tenuā nebulā circumfusum.

source: Her task was to monitor the docks and be the first to spot Admiral Deep Sea’s flagship, the Newins.
target: Eius munus erat vigilare ripam Portus Banamo et primum deprehendere navem praecipuam Admiralium Profundi Maris, Newins.

source: Of course, this was just one of her responsibilities.
target: Scilicet, hoc solum erat unum ex oneribus eius.

source: The most critical part was to ensure no Pirate King’s fleet arrived at Banamo Port before the Newins.
target: Pars maximi momenti erat cavere ne classis regis piratorum ad Portum Banamo ante Newins perveniret.

source: If that happened, she had to quickly inform Lumian so the unknown adventurer could disappear.
target: Si hoc eveniret, celeriter Lumiano certiorem facere debebat ut ignotus adventor evanescere posset.

source: Jenna paced back and forth or found a spot to sit, patiently waiting for her target.
target: Jenna circumambulabat aut locum sedendi inveniebat, patienter scopus suus exspectans.

source: Suddenly, she saw a colossal shape break the surface of the water, emerging from the depths.
target: Subito, vidit ingentem formam superficiem aquae rumpentem, ex profundis emergentem.

source: The massive object was jet black and metallic, with seawater cascading off its surface.
target: Res ingens erat nigerrima et metallina, cum undae maris ex eius superficie labentes.

source: It resembled an elongated, inflated spindle with a thin, curved metal tube extending from its top like a snail’s eye stalk.
target: Illud simile erat fusiformi, inflato, cum tenuo tubo metallico curvato, quod ex sua parte superiore protrahitur, velut pedunculus oculi cochleae.

source: In the next moment, the metal tube retracted, and the upper half of the behemoth split open, unfolding outward to reveal a broad deck, numerous cannons, and hundreds of pirates.
target: In momento sequenti, tubus metallicus retractus est, et dimidium superius ingentis rei disiunctum est, expandens se exterius ut patefieret latam platam, multas tormentas, et centena piratarum.

source: Masts and sails were raised.
target: Masta et vela sublevata erant.

source: Jenna was momentarily mesmerized.
target: Jenna paulisper stupuit.

source: Though Lumian had described how Bone Splitter Basil’s Black Octopus submerged, surfaced, and unfolded, seeing it in person was stunning.
target: Quamquam Lumian exposuerat quomodo Octopus Nigra Bone Splitter Basil se submergeret, appareret, et evolveretur, videre hoc in persona stupendum erat.

source: There was a strong sense of mechanical beauty!
target: Exsistebat vehementer sensus pulchritudinis machinalis!

source: Moreover, the behemoth was no smaller than the latest steam-powered ocean liners, vastly superior to traditional sailing pirate ships.
target: Praeterea, ingens non erat minor quam novissimae vecturae oceani, vaporibus impelluntur, longe praevalens navibus piraticis traditis.

source: Jenna didn’t need further confirmation to know this was Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine’s flagship, the Newins.
target: Jenna ulteriores confirmationes non requirere debuit ad cognoscendum hanc esse navem praecipuam Admiralium Profundi Maris Howl Constantine, Newins.

source: She quickly deduced that the Newins had arrived alone, without the Black Octopus.
target: Celeriter intellexit Newins solum adventum esse, sine Octopus Nigro.

source: Since Vice Admiral Dusk Bulatov Ivan became the King of Dusk, other ships in Admiral Deep Sea’s fleet rarely traveled with the flagship.
target: Cum Vice-Admiralis Dusk Bulatov Ivan Rex Crepusculi factus esset, ceterae naves in classe Admiralium Profundi Maris raro secum cum navibus praecipuis navigabant.

source: The Newins and the Black Octopus could submerge and travel secretly, which other ships couldn’t do.
target: Newins et Octopus Niger se mergere et clamiter iter facere poterant, quod ceterae naves non poterant.

source: Forcing them to follow would only expose Howl Constantine’s movements.
target: Eorum coactio ut sequerentur tantum revelaret motus Howl Constantine.

source: This was one reason Franca had targeted Admiral Deep Sea.
target: Hoc erat una ex causis cur Franca destinaverat Admiralium Profundi Maris.

source: What a beautiful piece of alchemical machinery… Jenna thought, staring at the Newins.
target: Quam pulcherrimum opus machinae alchemicae… cogitavit Jenna, Newins intuens.

source: Her father had been a worker, and his appreciation for machinery had deeply influenced her and her brother Julien.
target: Pater eius operarius fuerat, et eius aestimatio machinarum altissime eam et fratrem Julien afflixit.

source: With Trier full of all sorts of useful and odd machines, Julien had almost given up his faith in the Eternal Blazing Sun in his youth to join the God of Steam and Machinery’s Church.
target: Cum Trier pleno esset variis machinis utilibus et insolitis, Julien paene fidem suam iuvenili in Sol Aeterno Ardentis relinquere decrevit, ut Ecclesiam Dei Vaporis et Machinarum adiret.

source: Jenna withdrew her gaze and walked away from the dock, somewhat worried about something else.
target: Jenna oculos avertit et a ripa discessit, paulo de alio sollicita.

source: Her brother Julien would return to Trier in just over a month after his exchange studies.
target: Frater eius Julien ad Trier rediturus erat paululum post studia commutativa.

source: She didn’t want him to continue living in this dangerous city built on a “caldera.”
target: Noluit ut permaneret in hac urbe periculosa, super calderam constructa.

source: She wanted Julien to settle in a place with strong official forces but not as dangerous as Trier.
target: Volebat Julien collocari in loco ubi vires officiales robustae essent, sed non tam periculosa quam Trier.

source: Port LeSeur, where he was currently staying, or another similar town would be ideal.
target: Portus LeSeur, ubi nunc mansurabat, aut aliud simile oppidum idoneum foret.

source: Jenna knew she couldn’t persuade Julien.
target: Jenna scivit se Julien persuadere non posse.

source: He would worry about her unless she found a reliable person to marry.
target: Ipse de ea sollicite esset, nisi aliquem fidum ad nuptias inveniret.

source: Besides, Julien had grown up in Trier, and it offered him more opportunities.
target: Praeterea, Julien in Trier creverat, et ei plures opportunitates obtulit.

source: How could he leave his hometown?
target: Quomodo domum suam relinquere posset?

source: I need to find a way, something temporary to convince him.
target: Mihi viam invenire oportet, aliquid temporarium ut eum convincam.

source: Permanent relocation is something Julien would never accept.
target: Migratio perpetua est res quam Julien numquam acciperet.

source: As Franca said, maybe try for three years, then another three… Jenna didn’t consider having Anthony directly “hypnotize” Julian.
target: Ut Franca dixit, fortasse tribus annis conari, deinde aliis tribus; Jenna non consideravit Anthony directe "hypnotizaret" Julianum.

source: Just then, two drunken pirates stumbled onto the dock and spotted Jenna in her hooded, dress-like outfit.
target: Mox duo piratae ebrii in ripam inciderunt et Jennam in habitu cucullato, simili vesti, conspexerunt.

source: They looked her up and down for a few seconds, exchanged glances, and blocked her path.
target: Illi eam desuper et deorsum per paucos secundos intuentes, oculos inter se commutaverunt, atque iter eius obstruxerunt.

source: “Hey lady, name your price.”
target: “Heus, domina, profer pretium tuum.”

source: “If you don’t want to, we’ll just decide for ourselves!”
target: “Si non vis, nos ipsi decernemus!”

source: As they spoke, the pirates reached out to grab Jenna.
target: Dum loquebantur, piratae manum extendere ad Jennam apprehendendam conati sunt.

source: In Banamo Port, this wasn’t uncommon.
target: In Portu Banamo, hoc non erat insolitum.

source: Local women either worked as streetwalkers in protected places like bars or stayed home to avoid attracting pirates.
target: Feminae locales aut ut meretrices in locis tutis, ut tabernis, laborabant aut domi manebant, ne piratae illas allicerent.

source: The best outcome would be the arrival of the sheriff and receive compensation, and the worst would be being killed on the spot by pirates unwilling to pay, their bodies thrown into the sea or taken aboard a ship and sold elsewhere.
target: Optimum evenire esset adventus praefecti cum compensatione, et pessimum, ut statim a piratis, solvere recusantibus, occideretur, corpora eorum in mare iacta aut in navem capta et alibi vendita.

source: Before the pirates could touch her, they suddenly found themselves engulfed in silent, evil black flames.
target: Priusquam piratae eam contingere possent, subito se invenerunt implicatos in flammis silentibus, maleficis, nigerrimis.

source: They felt a surge of fear and pain, sobering up instantly, and turned to flee in terror.
target: Impulsum timoris et doloris sensissent, statim sobrii facti, et in terrore fugere conversi sunt.

source: As they ran, they screamed, “Witch!”
target: Dum currerent, clamaverunt, “Striga!”

source: “Witch!”
target: “Striga!”

source: Jenna felt a bit of her Witch potion digest from their fear and pain.
target: Jenna sensit aliquantulum potionis suae Strigae, ex eorum timore et dolore digesta.

source: She watched them weaken under the black flames, collapsing and dying as they ran.
target: Illos aspexit sub flammis nigris debilari, corruentes atque morientes dum fugerunt.

source: Jenna then faced a dilemma.
target: Jenna deinde dilemma occurritabat.

source: Should I maintain the mysterious and evil image of a Witch or follow my instincts and take the money from their corpses…
target: Num servare debeam imaginem arcanae et mali Strigae, aut instinctus meos sequi atque pecuniam ex cadaveribus eorum sumere?

source: In a bar in Banamo Port.
target: In taberna in Portu Banamo.

source: Anthony sat on a barstool with a mug of beer, listening to a pirate across from him boast.
target: Anthony in subsellio tabernae sedebat, poculum cervisiae tenens, et audiebat piratam adversus se gloriantem.

source: His task for the past two days had been to blend in with the pirates, monitor, and guide the “public opinion.”
target: Munus eius per duas dies praeteritas fuit se miscere cum piratis, observare et ducere "opinionem publicam."

source: Although Lumian had analyzed a lot, he wasn’t entirely sure how the pirate community would react.
target: Quamquam Lumian multa perspexerat, non plane certus erat quomodo communitas piratica agirentur.

source: Human nature was unpredictable, and among so many pirates, it was normal for some to act in ways that defied logic.
target: Natura humana erat incerta, et inter tot piratas, normale erat ut quidam agerentur modis rationi repugnandis.

source: A Conspirer couldn’t predict events with certainty like a high-ranked Seer, Prophet, or Spectator.
target: Conspirator eventus certe praedicere non poterat, sicut summi vates, prophetae aut spectatores.

source: They needed to prepare extra measures to ensure things went as planned and not fall apart at the first deviation.
target: Extra mensuras parare oportebat, ut res prout destinatae evenirent nec in prima aberratione corruerent.

source: So, Anthony frequented the pirates’ favorite bars, making as many friends as possible to understand their reactions to the unknown adventurer’s provocations.
target: Itaque Anthony popinas piraticas carissimas frequentavit, complurimos amicos faciens, ut eorum responsiones ad incognitum adventorem provocantem intellegeret.

source: He identified voices that could significantly influence the outcome and used his Hypnotist abilities to quietly guide and change the attitudes of a few influential pirates, ensuring the public opinion matched Lumian’s goals.
target: Voces agnovit quae exitum significanter afficere poterant, et facultatibus hypnoticis utendo tacite dirigere atque morum aliquot piratarum influentium mutandas curavit, ut opinio publica Lumian propositis congrueret.

source: This large-scale, covert guidance helped Anthony digest a good portion of his Hypnotist potion.
target: Haec directa latiore atque occulta Anthony adiuvit ut bonam partem potionis hypnoticae suae digereret.

source: It involved actual hypnosis and seemed to indirectly guide the collective psyche of the pirates in Banamo Port.
target: Hoc implicabat hypnosim veram atque videbatur indirecte dirigere animum collectivum piratarum in Portu Banamo.

source: Gulping down golden beer, the pirate beside Anthony admired his new friend.
target: Cervisiam auream degustans, pirata iuxta Anthony novum amicum suum admirabatur.

source: To him, this new friend was not only amiable but also a good listener among pirates, not interrupting to show off during others’ stories.
target: Ei, hic novus amicus non solum amabilis erat, sed etiam bonus auditor inter piratas, qui non intercipiebat ut se ostenderet in fabulis aliorum.

source: “Holy Lord of Storms, it’s rare to meet a pirate like this. I finally got to finish my story!”
target: “Sancte Domine Tempestatum, raro est talem piratam convenire. Denique fabulam meam conficere potui!”

source: The pirate Stilwell praised the god in his heart and asked Anthony, “Interested in joining our crew?”
target: Pirata Stilwell deum in corde suo laudavit et Anthony rogavit: “Visne nostram classem iungere?”

source: Anthony smiled and replied, “I don’t think I’m skilled enough to be one of you.”
target: Anthony subridens respondit: “Non puto me satis peritum esse ut unus ex vobis sim.”

source: “Haha.” Stilwell laughed proudly.
target: “Haha.” Stilwell superbe risit.

source: Anthony glanced around and lowered his voice, “Have you heard about the unknown adventurer?”
target: Anthony circumspiciens et vocem deminuens dixit: “Audivistine de ignoto adventore?”

source: Stilwell’s smile vanished instantly.
target: Risus Stilwell subito evanuit.

source: “Yeah, I heard. There’s so many pirate captains here, but none have taught that adventurer a lesson!”
target: “Ita, audivi. Hic tot capitanei piratorum sunt, sed nemo huic adventori rem monitionis instituit!”

source: “What are they waiting for? This is their chance to gain more fame. They might even become the tenth Pirate Admiral!”
target: “Quid ergo exspectant? Haec eorum occasio ad ampliandam famam est. Forsitan etiam decimus Admiralis Piraticus fieri possint!”

source: In his rant, Stilwell never mentioned challenging the arrogant adventurer himself.
target: In sua oratione, Stilwell numquam memor fuit provocandi ipsius arroganti adventori.

source: Suddenly, a commotion erupted in the bar.
target: Subito, tumultus in taberna exarsit.

source: “What’s happening?” Stilwell picked up his beer and mumbled, heading towards the table.
target: “Quid fit?” Stilwell cerevisiam suam tollens mormoravit, ad mensam properans.

source: After a while, he returned to the bar, excitedly telling Anthony, “Admiral Deep Sea is in Banamo!”
target: Post aliquod tempus, ad tabernam rediit et excitatus Anthony dixit: “Admiralium Profundi Maris in Portu Banamo est!”

source: “Admiral Deep Sea is here?” Anthony looked delighted.
target: “Admiralium Profundi Maris hic est?” Anthony laetus videbatur.

source: “Yes, someone will teach that bastard a lesson!” Stilwell sat back on his stool, enthusiastically, “That’s a Pirate Admiral! Every Pirate Admiral earned their title through real battles, not just boasting. They could kill all the adventurers here if they wanted to!”
target: “Ita, aliquis huic nefando rem monitionis dabit!” Stilwell in sellā recubuit, alacriter dicens: “Hic est Admiralis Piraticus! Omnis Admiralis Piraticus titulum suum per vera proelia meritus est, non solum per gloriationem. Omnes adventores hic interficere posse poterant, si velissent!”

source: When Stilwell finished, Anthony echoed, “I’m already looking forward to it.”
target: Cum Stilwell finem fecit, Anthony respondit: “Iam id exspecto.”

source: Gulp. Stilwell picked up his beer mug again and took a sip.
target: Gulp. Stilwell iterum poculum cerevisiae levavit et sorciens.

source: He boasted, “I thought Admiral Deep Sea would come to end the humiliation caused by those so-called notable pirates.”
target: Ille gloriatus est, “Putabam Admiralem Profundi Maris venturum esse ut finem imponeret humiliationi a piratis dictis notabilibus.”

source: “Why do you say that?” Anthony asked curiously.
target: “Cur id dicis?” Anthony curiose interrogavit.

source: Stilwell glanced at him. “You don’t know?”
target: Stilwell eum aspexit: “Nescis?”

source: Anthony smiled and explained, “Although I’m from Intis, our boss often intercepts ships in the Berserk Sea and rarely comes to the Fog Sea.”
target: Anthony subridens explicavit: “Etsi ex Intis sum, dominus noster saepe naves in Mari Furenti intercipit et raro ad Mari Nebulosi venit.”

source: “That explains it.” Stilwell nodded understandingly. He lowered his voice, “We suspect Admiral Deep Sea comes to Banamo Port every year to find that legendary treasure.”
target: “Illud rationem dat.” Stilwell caput intellegenter annuit. Vocem deminuens dixit: “Suspicimus Admiralem Profundi Maris quotannis ad Portum Banamo venire ut illud thesaurum legendarium inveniat.”

source: “Treasure? The Lost Newins?” Anthony acted like a genuine pirate.
target: “Thesaurus? Novins Perditus?” Anthony se quasi verus pirata gessit.

source: The Lost Newins was one of the most famous treasure legends on the Five Seas, rumored to be at the bottom of a certain part of the Fog Sea.
target: Novins Perditus erat una ex clarissimis fabulis thesaurorum in Quinque Mariis, diciturque in imo alicuius partis Maris Nebulosi esse.

source: It was said to be the site of an ancient civilization of intelligent beings, long destroyed.
target: Dicitur fuisse situs antiqui civilizationis ingeniarum, iam diu deleta.

source: Strange items often appeared in the area, all pointing to the ancient Newins.
target: Res insolitae saepe in regione apparuerunt, omnes ad antiquam Novins referentes.

source: “Yes.” Stilwell nodded emphatically. “Think about it. Admiral Deep Sea’s flagship was found in some ruins and named the Newins. Anyone would suspect those ruins are the Lost Newins! Besides, the area where the Newins supposedly sank isn’t far from here.”
target: “Ita.” Stilwell emphaticē annuit. “Cogita illud: navis praecipua Admiralis Profundi Maris in nonnullis ruinis inventa est et ‘Newins’ nominata; quisquis suspicaret has ruinas Novins Perditas esse. Praeterea, regio in qua putatur Newins submersa esse, non longe ab hoc sit.”
